patch 0: toolchain-diff — CL CSE'd the two -1 short stores (curThing+0x62, +0x58) into 'b8 ffffffff + 66 a3 x2' even with volatile externs (volatile does not defeat same-const store CSE in CL 4.2); FA materializes each as an immediate store '66 c7 05 <addr> ffff', so the whole 23B CL block (b8/8a-hoist/2x66a3) is rewritten to FA's 18B two-imm-store block; DIR32 newsites at span 3 and 12 carry the target dwords (curThing via _w29d_c0 map, contents 0x62/0x58 baked in the hex)
